description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +20000], [Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode I (Noctis - Earth)], [Awoken Kings of Old] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode I (Noctis - Earth)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, equipped Earth abilities deal 10%/20%/30% more damage after casting 1/2/3+ Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode II (Noctis - Earth)], removes [Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode I (Noctis - Earth)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode II (Noctis - Earth)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 30000, Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Earth abilities, critical chance =100%, attacks deal 10%/20% additional critical damage after using 1/2+ Earth abilities

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Awoken Kings of Old
description.text: Grants Heavy Charge +1 to the user after using Earth abilities
